disclaimer.body: MirrorPilot is a free community project. It does not run mirrors of its own and it does not proxy image traffic. It measures sources that others operate, and helps you copy images into a registry you control.
disclaimer.no_warranty: Provided as is, with no warranty. See the licence for details.
disclaimer.official_only: Third-party mirrors are convenient, not authoritative. Check a digest against the official registry when it matters.
disclaimer.title: Before you rely on this

setup.explainer: The password has two jobs. It logs you in, and it derives the key that encrypts the GitHub and registry credentials you store later. Neither is written to disk.
setup.password_hint: At least %d characters. It also encrypts the credentials you save here, so if you lose it they cannot be recovered.
